stem: Which ending result or final point follows “David spent half an hour cleaning.”?
options: A memory does not always need proof to be real.
He learned that small messes do not always stay small.
They saw it as a message: what people throw away does not always stay where they leave it.
May learned that some advice works for more than umbrellas.
